test_title: PYST 25: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: SS 14 is related to WP −4 in a certain way. In the same way, CE 10 is related to GB −8. To which of the given options is QG 1 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is,

 
• For the **first letter**, it shifts **+4** positions forward in the English alphabetical order.
 
• For the **second letter**, it shifts **-3** positions backward in the English alphabetical order.
 
• For the **number**, it decreases by **-18**.

Let's verify this logic with the given examples:

**For 'SS 14' related to 'WP -4':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c688816826e835c52e6be19f99ccb2111241903089d42f95cf62949240a9be4.png] 

**For 'CE 10' related to 'GB -8':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b22b635deadd47db53f6d730ddbb6cfe3331cabcf33962d52fa67fdfd6e7382c.png] 

The consistent pattern observed is: **First letter +4, Second letter -3, Number -18**.

**Applying the same logic to 'QG 1':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba8451ded3b5170d88dc9640547f3f4b7095c40813e466c38c672e42488c9c9c.png] 

Thus, 'QG 1' is related to **UD -17**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
